text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Narita Taishin in town
holding what appeared to be a present, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This... for Creek-san—
...No. There's no way I can convey my feelings like this...!

Perhaps the "training to be honest" from her two best friends the other day worked,
as she seemed resolved to hand over the present.
Although, she still seemed unable to take that very last step...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shoot, she's already here...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting~♪
Taishin-chan!
Thanks for inviting me~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, where are we going today?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Eh... w-where, or rather...
I wanted to... give you a present, um...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I see~!
You want me to help you pick out
a present for one of your friends, right~?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... what should I do.
I can't find the right timing to give it to her...!)

text_block_list.name: Public Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"Our sale is currently underway!
Why not show your daily gratitude to that special someone
with a lovely gift...♪"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Urk...
Yeah, exactly. I have to tell her soon—)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan? ...Hmm,
there are so many options it's hard to choose!
Shall we take a break for a bit♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ thanks for the treat!
That was so delicious~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... in the end, I still haven't given it to her...
What are you hesitating for, idiot!)

text_block_list.name: Woman in Couple
text_block_list.text:
—Here, a present for you!
Ehehe, I picked it out with you in mind♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I picked it out... thinking of Creek-san too, didn't I...
wondering what would be good, if she'd be happy with it...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(And—
I decided I was definitely giving it to her today, didn't I...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(All right... I'm giving it to her,
I'm definitely giving it to her... This time for sure—!)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The person you want to give that present to
must be very precious to you, Taishin-chan.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can tell just by looking at your face.
After all, we've known each other for a long time, haven't we~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Aargh, enough! Just for right now...
be honest—me!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
............Yeah. That's right.
...So—take this!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I wanted to give this to you today...
But I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I-In the first place, I bought this apron
quite a while ago, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
While saying 'I gotta give it to her'... time just passed...
and it became harder to hand over...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But............ I decided...!
That I'd convey... my honest feelings—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, as always... Creek-san.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
............Kh, Taishin-chan!
!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd do all this for me!
I'm, I'm—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: *Huuuug*~~~~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, wha—?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Kh............ Haaah~.
Only for today, okay...?

From what I could see from a distance,
it looked like she managed to give her the present safely.
The following day—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You took care of me during practice, so...
I just hate having debts hanging over me. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ~~~kh... Don't treat me like a kid!!

As I watched from a distance,
Narita Taishin pushed through the crowd and ran over to me.
choice_data_list: Were you able to give her the present?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez! Shut up!
I don't have time for this right now!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It's just a little token of my appreciation~!
Taishin-cha~n!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I said, words are more than enough for a thank-you!!
